heading: FD Details in Consolidated Account Statement: What it Means for Investors
tldr: The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) is set to integrate Fixed Deposit (FD) details into the Consolidated Account Statement (CAS).
This initiative aims to provide investors with a single, comprehensive view of their bank deposits and other investments.
The implementation of this enhanced CAS is expected to be completed by December 31, 2026.
Investors will soon be able to track their bank FDs alongside mutual fund holdings and demat account investments in one place.
This move is designed to simplify financial portfolio tracking, aid in better asset allocation, and improve overall financial planning.
caption:
Imagine seeing all your money in one place! Soon, your Fixed Deposit (FD) details will join your other investments in a single, easy-to-read statement. This means you'll track your FDs, mutual funds, and shares all together, making it super simple to see your full financial picture. This big change is coming by 2026. Want to know more?
